headline: Neurable launches EEG headphones to track focus and brain battery
summary: Neurable launched a new pair of EEG-equipped headphones, the Neurable One, designed to monitor brainwaves and help users stay focused. The company says the device can flag the best time to take a break and track a battery-like level that signals when a recharge is needed.

claims.statement: Neurable launched new EEG-equipped, brain-scanning headphones, the Neurable One, designed to monitor focus and brainwaves.

sources.quote: Neurable’s First Brain-Scanning Headphones Want to Fine-Tune Your Focus
Neurable launches its newest brain-scanning headphones
a new pair of EEG-equipped headphones to keep an eye on your brainwaves while you work, rest and play
